messages:
Noah (docs): quick heads-up: opened PR to patch docs/known-issues with the outage status link + an emergency workaround for the KV-cache eviction symptom. need a fast review/merge today.
Priya (platform): can you paste the exact status page URL so i can validate the reference? customers will land there.
Noah (docs): here: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/2026-03-18-region-outage
Marta (docs-reviewer): i'll scan it now. is this purely link + 3 lines of steps? we should mark it as temporary to auto-clean later.
Noah (docs): yes, added heading "Temporary workaround" and three bullets: flush local prefix cache, set write batch size to 1, disable permissive batching.
ci-bot: docs-preview: build started for PR #4399
Sam (oncall): quick note: previews have been failing on leftover ./legacy links. avoid any relative paths to legacy pages.
Noah (docs): good catch — i used an old anchor in one spot. fixing and pushing now.
ci-bot: docs-preview failed: 1 broken link -> ./legacy/kv-guide.md
Noah (docs): replaced the legacy ref with /docs/kv-guide.md anchor and updated the anchor name to kv-cache-eviction-workaround.
ci-bot: deploy-preview-4399 live: https://deploy-preview-4399--redwood-docs.netlify.app/docs/known-issues/#kv-cache-eviction-workaround
Marta (docs-reviewer): looked at preview, wording fine. LGTM. Priya, any objections to merge+backport?
Priya (platform): no objections. i'll merge and create backport to release/stable after merge.
Noah (docs): thank you! filing a follow-up to add this to the runbook and reference in the incident postmortem.
